jobs.title: VP, Engineering Operations
jobs.description:
Who We Are

We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) At Redis, you’ll work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business—whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

Why would you love this job?

Engineering Operations is a high-leverage function within the CTO organization. Its purpose is to make Engineering and Cloud Operations execution legible, commitments durable, and leadership time scalable—primarily through clarity, technical depth, and strategic influence.

As VP, Engineering Operations, you will build and evolve the operating system of the CTO organization while steering the AI transformation of our engineering and cloud infrastructure operations. You will work across Engineering, Cloud Ops, and product partners to create confidence in delivery, surface technical risks early, drive modern AI-enabled engineering workflows, and empower leaders to focus on long-term strategy and architectural outcomes.

This is a highly visible role for a deeply technical operator who can move comfortably between software architecture, cloud platforms, AI-driven automation, data, and organizational dynamics. You will succeed not by adding bureaucracy, but by introducing intelligent, modern structures for better architectural decisions, clear ownership, and scalable execution.

What You’ll Do

Own the Engineering operating system

Design, run, and continuously improve the CTO organization’s operating cadence, including quarterly business reviews, initiative and program reviews, goal-setting cycles, leadership forums, and internal communications.
Establish lightweight, reusable standards for agendas, pre-reads, synthesis, status, risk and confidence language, ownership, dependencies, decision capture, and follow-through.
Turn fragmented execution signals into concise, decision-ready narratives for the CTO and Engineering leadership.
Ensure forums drive decisions and tradeoffs—not simply status updates.

Create execution visibility and confidence

Make Engineering priorities, commitments, dependencies, and risks visible across the company.
Improve the quality and timeliness of early risk detection and escalation.
Use data and qualitative signals together to distinguish real progress from activity or optimism.

Align priorities, people, and investment

Partner with the CTO, Engineering leaders, Finance, People, Product, and other functions to connect strategy, priorities, capacity, headcount, funding, and operating norms.
Support workforce and headcount planning, financial and investment alignment, and organizational planning with clear analysis and decision materials.
Improve cross-geo and cross-functional operating norms so expectations are explicit rather than assumed.

Provide leverage on strategic and special initiatives

Bring structure to ambiguous, cross-cutting, or high-risk initiatives that do not yet have a natural program home.
Support high-impact company priorities such as major transformations, IPO readiness, M&A diligence, or other initiatives requiring CTO-level coordination.
Know when to stay involved, when to escalate, and when to exit so Engineering Operations does not become a permanent dependency.

Build durable operating muscle

Institutionalize good judgment into reusable systems, templates, and standards.
Use automation, analytics, and AI-assisted workflows thoughtfully to improve signal quality and operating leverage.
Socialize changes effectively and build adoption through clarity, usefulness, and trust—not compliance theater.

Drive AI Transformation in Engineering and Cloud Operations

Architect and execute strategic initiatives that integrate AI technologies into software development lifecycles, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations to accelerate innovation and developer efficiency.
Establish frameworks and benchmarks to evaluate the adoption, effectiveness, and impact of AI tools across engineering and cloud infrastructure teams.
Lead cross-functional programs focused on automated observability, AI-driven incident management, and intelligent cloud resource optimization.

What will you need to have?

Deep technical background in software engineering, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure operations alongside experience in a strategic leadership or business operations role.
A demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous, cross-functional problems into clear decisions, ownership, operating mechanisms, and measurable outcomes.
Experience designing and running operating cadences, business reviews, planning processes, leadership forums, or comparable mechanisms that improve execution.
The ability to influence without relying on formal authority and to build trust across geographies, functions, and levels of the organization.
Comfort working in a fast-changing environment with incomplete information and competing priorities.

Extra Great If You Have

Experience supporting a CTO, VP Engineering, or comparable technology executive in a high-growth or transformation environment.
Experience with annual planning, portfolio management, headcount planning, financial modeling, or investment reviews.
Experience supporting IPO readiness, M&A diligence, organizational transformation, or other enterprise-scale change.
Experience building operating standards, metrics, dashboards, or lightweight automation that materially improves decision quality.
Hands-on experience designing or deploying AI tooling, LLM integrations, AI-assisted coding, or automated ops platforms within large-scale engineering or cloud environments.

We Give Back To Our Employees

Our culture is what makes Redis a fun and rewarding place to work. To support you at work and beyond, we offer all our US team members fantastic benefits and perks:

Competitive salaries and equity grants
Unlimited time off to promote a healthy work-life balance
H/D/V coverage along with 401K, FSA, and commuter benefits
Frequent team celebrations and recreation events
Home internet & phone stipend
Learning and development opportunities
Ability to influence a high-performance company on its way to IPO

The estimated gross base annual salary range for this role is $275,000 - 3000,000 per year in New York, California, Washington, Colorado, and Rhode Island. Actual compensation may vary and is dependent on various factors, including a candidate’s work location, qualifications, experience, and competencies. Base annual salary is one component of Redis’ total compensation and competitive benefits package, which may include 401(k), unlimited time off, learning and development opportunities, and comprehensive health and wellness benefits. This role may include discretionary bonuses, stock options, commuter benefits based on location, or a commission plan. Salary history is not used in compensation package decisions. Redis utilizes market pay data to determine compensation, so posted compensation ranges are subject to change as new market data becomes available.

As a global company, we value a culture of curiosity, diversity of thought, and innovation from our employees, customers, and partners. Redis is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment where all employees’ differences are celebrated and supported, and everyone feels safe to bring their authentic selves to work. Redis is dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, Veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. We strive to create a workplace where every voice is heard, and every idea is respected.

Redis is committed to working with and providing access and reasonable accommodation to applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you think you may require accommodations for any part of the recruitment process, please send a request to recruiting@redis.com. All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.

jobs.title: Director, Technology & Product
jobs.description:
About Univerus

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Burnaby, British Columbia, Univerus is a fast-growing enterprise software company specializing in vertical market solutions. With over 300 employees, more than 20 acquisitions, and a global customer base exceeding 3,500 organizations, Univerus delivers mission-critical technology across public and private sectors. Our flagship product, Unity ERP, powers operations in local government, utilities, construction, manufacturing, health and safety, education, and beyond.

Learn more at univerus.com.

About Bu

Since 1981, Baragar Systems has partnered with K–12 school districts across Canada and the United States to provide data-driven planning tools that transform complex enrolment, boundary, staffing, and demographic data into clear, confident decisions. Serving more than 100 school districts, Baragar has built a reputation for deep educational planning expertise and meaningful impact on how education leaders plan for the future. Our product suite includes Demographic Dynamics (enrolment forecasting), GeoSchool (boundary planning and analysis), ThemeMap (geographic data visualization), District Intelligence (data dashboards and reporting), Staff Allocator, School Locator and School Boundaries Online. All tools purpose-built for the unique planning challenges school districts face. Baragar has historically operated as a service-first organization. Each year, the team delivers custom geospatial and demographic data packages, assembled by experienced data analysts and GIS specialists, alongside an annual software deliverable. Deep client engagement, hands-on support, and tailored training are central to how Baragar works. This model has created strong, trust-based relationships, and that expertise remains a core part of who we are.

Baragar operates as a focused business unit within Univerus, combining the intimacy and expertise of a specialist team with the scale and investment of a growing global organization.

Learn more at baragar.com

Position Details

Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

Salary Range: $120,000 to $145,000 CAD per year

Location: Surrey, BC, Canada - Hybrid

This is a replacement position.

Role Overview

Baragar is entering a new chapter, one that builds on decades of service excellence while developing stronger internal accountability for its technology and product direction. The domain expertise, client relationships, and delivery capability that define Baragar today are what we’re building from, and what we’re committed to protecting as we grow. We are now establishing clearer in-house leadership over product direction, a more deliberate approach to technology decision-making, and the capacity to develop internal technical capability alongside our existing development partnerships.

We are seeking a Director, Technology & Product to lead that work. This is a senior role spanning five core areas: leading change, technology leadership and modernization, product and delivery management, building internal capability, and budget and governance. The successful candidate will hold both the strategic and the operational; someone who understands legacy systems, manages vendor and delivery relationships with confidence, brings clear technology judgment, and has the presence and discipline to drive meaningful change in an organization with a long operational history. This is a role focused on forward momentum, building on what works while creating the conditions for meaningful change. It is not a purely strategic role; the person who succeeds here will be equally comfortable doing the work as directing it: writing requirements, staying close to delivery, and investing the time to deeply understand Baragar’s domain, its data, and how the organization operates before

driving change. They will have a direct hand in shaping what Baragar’s technology foundation looks like over the next several years. The expectation, and the commitment from the organization, is that this investment of time and understanding comes first.

Organizational Relationship

This role reports directly to the EVP of Baragar Systems and operates as the senior internal technology voice for the business unit. The Director, Technology & Product works closely with external development partners who currently deliver all of the product work, as well as with Baragar’s data analysts, GIS specialists, and client-facing staff. The role operates within Baragar’s structure as a focused business unit of Univerus but will engage with

Univerus technical leadership on strategic alignment and collaborate with counterparts in other business units.

Key Responsibilities

Leading Change

Act as the senior internal technology voice in leadership discussions, vendor discussions, and strategic planning, bringing clarity and confidence to complex technical decisions.
Hold the organization accountable to transformation milestones, engaging teams and leadership with clarity and credibility, while respecting the expertise and customer value already built into the business.
Communicate technology direction, progress, and change clearly across the broader organization ensuring parties at all levels understand the why, not just the what.

Technology Leadership & Modernization

Develop a deep understanding of Baragar’s existing products, development workflows, codebases, data structures, and hosting environments.
Lead the development and execution of a practical modernization roadmap for Baragar’s product suite, sequencing technology improvements in a way that reduces technical debt, ensures customer value is protected, and remains within approved budget parameters.
Evaluate options for cloud hosting, application architecture, database strategy, integrations, APIs, reporting, and security, and develop business cases to support recommendations.
Provide internal leadership of technical decision-making, building stronger in-house capability to complement existing development partnerships and ensure Baragar has clear internal direction on core product and architecture decisions.
Establish, evolve, or maintain development standards, release processes, documentation practices, code review expectations, QA processes, and security practices.

Product & Delivery Management

Stay actively involved in delivery at a working level, reviewing specifications, participating in development cycles, and maintaining enough technical depth to make informed decisions and spot problems early.
Lead the planning, resourcing, timelines, and delivery across multiple software products.
Oversee backlog management, release planning, and production support.
Manage and maintain strong working relationships with external development partners, ensuring delivery alignment, clear expectations, and mutual accountability for quality and timelines.
Partner with staff at all levels to translate organizational needs into clear technical priorities.
Translate between stakeholder requirements and technical constraints, turning business needs into clear development requirements and technical trade-offs into decisions leadership can act on.
Manage risks, budgets, and priorities to achieve the best possible outcome within approved parameters.

Building Internal Capability

Strengthen the documented, internally owned understanding of Baragar’s products and codebase, working collaboratively with existing partners and internal team members to build on what has already been captured, formalize what hasn’t, and ensure institutional knowledge continues to

transfer and grow over time.

Define the internal technical capabilities, roles, skills, and tooling, that Baragar needs to develop or acquire as the organization evolves, and build a practical plan for closing those gaps over time.
Identify the right opportunities to selectively build internal development capacity in areas where closer day-to-day ownership will best support Baragar’s next stage of growth, while maintaining effective and collaborative relationships with existing partners.

Budget & Governance

Manage the technology and delivery budget, including invoice review, tracking, and variance reporting.
Provide regular financial and delivery updates to senior leadership, highlighting risks, variances, and forecast implications.
Operate within approved budgetary and strategic parameters while making informed recommendations on delivery tradeoffs and priorities.

Education And Experience

A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field is required.
An equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience may be considered. A graduate degree or MBA is an asset but not required.
A minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in technology leadership, with at least 3–5 years in a senior or director-level role at a software company. Experience in a smaller or mid-sized organization where you were close to the work, rather than directing large internal teams from a distance, is strongly preferred.
Experience within the educational planning field, particularly K–12, is considered an asset.

What We Offer

Health and Dental Coverage
RRSP/401K
EFAP
Generous Paid Time Off
Flexible Work Environment
Education Reimbursement Program

Our Commitment To Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

Univerus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and empowered to contribute fully. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences, including but not limited to Indigenous peoples, racialized persons, women, LGBTQ2S+ individuals, persons with disabilities, and veterans.

If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We are committed to working with you to ensure your needs are met.

Please note that we may use AI as part of our recruitment and hiring process. While we may incorporate select AI features to enhance process efficiency, we remain committed to human-led decision making. We recognize that AI is not perfect, so all AI-generated outputs are subject to human review to ensure accuracy and fairness. Our goal is to use technology to support, not replace, thoughtful human decision-making in recruitment and hiring.

Director, Finance Systems

Plusgrade is scaling across global entities and building toward public-company readiness, and our Finance systems need an architect who can turn complex accounting and control requirements into clean, automated infrastructure. If you want to own the Finance-side design of NetSuite and our broader financial tech stack from the ground up rather than maintain someone else's legacy setup, this seat is yours.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead current- and future-state Finance process design with domain leaders, applying modern, best-fit technology to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and accelerate cycle times. Translate needs into requirements and control criteria; define and track value and outcomes for related system, integration, and automation changes, including AI use cases.
Partner with the VP, Finance Technology & Automation and Finance leaders on roadmap and prioritization. Lead Finance-side discovery, process and control design, and initiative coordination.
Lead Finance-side evaluation and implementation of NetSuite and related platforms. Partner with the Director, Finance Automation and technical teams on architecture, integrations, configuration, testing, and launch; validate process and control fit and audit readiness before go-live.
Define Finance needs for data quality, reconciliations, and reporting; partner with technical and data teams to ensure Finance data flows are complete, reliable, and audit-ready.
Partner with application specialists and technical owners to maintain operational readiness for Finance systems, including user support, documentation, adoption, escalation paths, incident coordination, releases, and upgrades.
Lead, develop, and coach the team, setting clear expectations and building the capabilities needed to deliver Finance systems initiatives.
Set control requirements for finance systems and processes affecting financial reporting, including data integrity, access, segregation of duties, approvals, and change management. Partner with IT on SOX, ITGC, ICFR, and ITACs.
Lead audit readiness for Finance systems and application controls; coordinate evidence and track remediation with control owners, IT, and Finance to support public-company readiness.
Coordinate Finance-facing vendor relationships, including service reviews, escalations, and renewal or change recommendations.

What You Bring

10+ years of progressive experience in finance systems, enterprise applications, or a related field, including at least 5 years leading teams or major programs.
A track record of leading Finance-side requirements, process design, controls, and adoption for ERP implementations or transformations. NetSuite experience is strongly preferred, including partnering with technical owners on configuration, integrations, and change governance.
A bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business, or a related field; CPA or equivalent accounting designation is preferred.
Experience supporting global, multi-entity environments, ideally including M&A or business integrations.
Experience supporting a public company or pre-IPO environment is preferred.
Strong knowledge of Finance processes, accounting operations, financial reporting, and internal controls, including SOX/ITGC/ICFR, IT application controls (ITACs), and segregation-of-duties concepts; able to translate these into practical process and system requirements.
Experience with integrations, data architecture and governance, system security, and process automation. EPM, BI, or data-warehouse experience is an asset.
Clear communication and sound initiative leadership—you can facilitate process design with Finance leaders, define success measures and control requirements, influence across functions, and partner effectively with technical teams while balancing strategic direction with practical execution.
Experience evaluating or implementing AI-enabled solutions in Finance or Accounting workflows—such as transaction matching, reconciliations, invoice processing, close, reporting, or anomaly detection—with appropriate human review, data privacy, auditability, and control safeguards is an asset.

Travel is about the moments that make a journey feel personal. At Plusgrade, we build the technology that makes those moments possible, from upgrade offers and loyalty experiences to revenue tools used by 575+ airline, hospitality, cruise, rail, and financial services partners worldwide.

The work is global, complex, and rewarding. You will solve meaningful problems, take ownership from idea to outcome, and work alongside people who are smart, curious, and committed to doing great work.

Hybrid

Your Role And Responsibilities

This Director role is a strategic transformation position within ABB's NEMA International division, reporting to the EVP International Sales. The role is pivotal in building a scalable international business platform by strengthening alignment across Regions, Business Lines and functions, removing structural barriers to growth and driving implementation of the Stabilize-Optimize-Scale roadmap. The successful candidate will drive business transformation across regions while building scalable operating foundations, combining expertise in strategy execution, operating-model redesign, business process management, change leadership, and executive influence within a complex global matrix.

The work model for the role is: hybrid ;

The role is contributing to the Motion NEMA Motors division globally.

International travel of approximately 30-40% will be required for the role.

You will be mainly accountable for:

Own and drive the NEMA International transformation roadmap aligned with the Stabilize-Optimize-Scale journey, translating strategy into prioritized initiatives with clear outcomes, milestones and success measures while maintaining visibility of progress and risks to leadership.
Act as senior integrator between NEMA International and Global Business Lines, establishing governance mechanisms and cross-functional commitments that align product, portfolio, and investment priorities with international market requirements while escalating critical dependencies that constrain growth.
Lead resolution of systemic barriers at the interfaces between International Sales, Global Operations, IT, Finance, HR and other supporting functions, converting fragmented issues into prioritized root-cause initiatives with clear accountability and measurable outcomes.
Serve as custodian of the NEMA International target operating model, ensuring organizational accountabilities, governance, processes, technology and capabilities evolve coherently to enable profitable international growth, from stabilization through optimization and scale, while designing the organization for future growth and acquisitions.
Lead an executive-level International Transformation Office that manages the transformation portfolio, governance cadence, dependency view and risk escalation, mobilizing cross-functional workstreams and intervening to resolve ownership gaps, resource constraints or delayed decisions.
Lead adoption of the new international organization and ways of working through change leadership, stakeholder engagement and capability building, while establishing a continuous improvement framework that connects frontline issues to structural business improvements and embeds continuous improvement into leadership accountability.

Qualifications for the role:

Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in business transformation, strategy execution, operating-model design, commercial excellence, enterprise program leadership or management consulting.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Strategy, Operations, Information Systems or a related discipline.
Experience in an internal strategy, transformation, business excellence or consulting role.
Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation across multiple geographies or business units.
Proven ability to align senior stakeholders and functions behind a shared agenda without relying on direct authority.
Experience translating strategy into executable roadmaps, governance, operating mechanisms and measurable outcomes.
Strong business acumen and ability to connect transformation to customer value, growth, margin, cash, productivity and organizational capability.
Excellent executive communication, facilitation and synthesis skills.
Ability to constructively challenge established practices and navigate ambiguity with pace and judgement.
Familiarity with international commercial models, CRM/ERP environments and end-to-end customer processes.
Experience in an industrial, manufacturing, electromechanical or B2B technology environment is an advantage. Recognized transformation, change management, Lean, Six Sigma or program-management certification is a plus.
Fluent English language skills.

Nos convictions

Chez ABB, nous nous engageons à relever les défis mondiaux. Nos valeurs fondamentales — la bienveillance, le courage, la curiosité et la collaboration —combinées à notre engagement envers la diversité, l’inclusion et l’égalité des chances, sont au cœur de notre volonté de donner à chacun et chacune les moyens de créer des solutions durables.

Écrivez le prochain chapitre de votre histoire chez ABB.

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Ce poste de direction est axé sur la transformation stratégique au sein de la division NEMA International d’ABB et relève du vice-président exécutif, ventes internationales. Il joue un rôle essentiel dans la mise en place d’une plateforme d’affaires internationales évolutive en renforçant l’alignement entre les régions, les secteurs d’activité et les fonctions, en éliminant les obstacles structurels à la croissance et en pilotant la mise en œuvre de la feuille de route Stabiliser-Optimiser-Déployer à grande échelle. La personne retenue pilotera la transformation des activités dans les différentes régions tout en établissant des fondations opérationnelles évolutives, en mettant à profit son expertise en exécution de la stratégie, en refonte des modèles opérationnels, en gestion des processus d’affaires, en leadership du changement et en influence auprès de la haute direction dans une structure matricielle mondiale complexe.

Le mode de travail pour ce poste est : hybride;

Ce poste contribue aux activités de la division Moteurs NEMA du secteur Motion à l’échelle mondiale.

Ce poste exige des déplacements internationaux représentant environ 30 à 40 % du temps de travail.

Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

Prendre en charge et piloter la feuille de route de transformation de NEMA International, en cohérence avec le parcours Stabiliser-Optimiser-Déployer à grande échelle, en traduisant la stratégie en initiatives prioritaires assorties de résultats, de jalons et de critères de réussite clairs, tout en assurant à la direction une visibilité sur les progrès et les risques.
Agir comme principal point d’intégration entre NEMA International et les secteurs d’activité mondiaux, en établissant des mécanismes de gouvernance et des engagements interfonctionnels qui alignent les priorités en matière de produits, de portefeuille et d’investissements sur les exigences des marchés internationaux, tout en portant à l’attention de la direction les interdépendances critiques qui freinent la croissance.

The Alberta Public Service works to build a stronger province for current and future generations. We make a difference in the lives of Albertans through rewarding career opportunities.

The Ministry of Energy and Minerals is responsible for sustaining the interests of Albertans through the stewardship and responsible development of energy and mineral resource systems.

Please review Energy and Minerals to learn more and what it has to offer.

The Strategy and Market Access (SAMA) Division is responsible for developing Alberta's strategic direction to deliver on energy mandates including natural gas infrastructure development, market access, energy market diversification, strategic foresight, economic analysis, and stakeholder engagement.

The Energy Futures Branch leads the development and implementation of strategies related to natural gas infrastructure, value-add initiatives, export opportunities including liquefied natural gas (LNG) and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), critical minerals, emerging resources, and pipeline regulatory processes

The Unit of Emerging Resources is responsible for strategy development and implementation of Alberta’s critical minerals and geo-thermal resources.

Role Responsibilities

Are you a strategic thinker and collaborative leader? Energy Futures is looking for a Director, Emerging Resources to provide strategic leadership and advance Alberta’s critical minerals, geothermal energy, and other emerging resource opportunities.

Reporting to the Executive Director, Energy Futures, this position provides strategic leadership for the Department’s mandated initiatives related to critical minerals, geothermal and other emerging opportunities. The position leads professional teams responsible for strategy and legislative development, complex projects, and work across government and with external partners to advance complex policy, investment, regulatory, and market priorities.

In This Role, You Will

Provide strategic advice, analysis and recommendations, for policies, programs, and initiatives related to critical minerals, geothermal energy, and other emerging resources.
Lead strategy planning, legislative and regulatory development, implementation planning and evaluation for Alberta’s Critical Minerals Strategy and Action Plan and other emerging resource development initiatives.
Direct the preparation of decision documents, briefing notes, correspondence, cabinet and Treasury Board materials, key messages and other executive products.
Lead complex, cross-ministry and cross-jurisdictional initiatives including engagement with federal, provincial and territorial partnerships on critical minerals.
Build and sustain trusted relationships with federal counterparts and industry to advance Alberta’s interests and strategic outcomes on critical minerals and other emerging opportunities. Lead, coach, and develop managers and staff while fostering a collaborative, accountable, and results-oriented work environment.
Identify opportunities to strengthen Alberta’s competitiveness, attract investment, and support mineral exploration, development, processing, and value-added opportunities.
Direct complex policy, economic, technical, regulatory, and market analysis and provide evidence-based recommendations to senior and executive leadership.
Represent the department on intergovernmental committees, working groups, industry forums, and other strategic initiatives.
Lead unit operations, workforce planning, financial oversights, priority setting, staff development, issues management and coordination oversight and continuous improvement while managing competing priorities and emerging issues.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic and collaborative leader to influence Alberta’s energy and mineral future. Your leadership will help shape policies, strengthen partnerships, attract investment, and advance the responsible development of Alberta’s emerging resources.

The Job Description is provided for further details on this position.

APS Competencies

Competencies are behaviors that are essential to reach our goals in serving Albertans. We encourage you to have an in depth understanding of the competencies that are required for this opportunity and to be prepared to demonstrate them during the recruitment process.

Systems Thinking: You will consider the broader economic, regulatory, competitive, and market environment when developing strategies for critical minerals, geothermal energy, and emerging resources.
Build Collaborative Environments: You will build strategic relationships with industry, Indigenous organizations, regulators, other governments, and cross-ministry partners to advance emerging resource priorities.
Develop Self and Others: You will provide clear direction, coaching, and mentorship to managers and staff, empowering your team to deliver on complex priorities. This aligns with the APS emphasis on achieving results through others and setting clear expectations.
Creative Problem Solving: You will analyze complex policy, economic, regulatory, and market issues and develop practical, evidence-based options and recommendations for senior leadership.
Drive for Results: You will establish clear priorities and lead the delivery of high-profile strategic initiatives while balancing competing priorities and maintaining accountability for results.
Agility: You will anticipate and respond to emerging issues, changing government priorities, and evolving energy and mineral markets while providing timely strategic advice.

University graduation in Public Administration, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Science, or a related field, supplemented by seven (7) years of progressively responsible experience required in Leading complex strategic initiatives, and issues management

Related experience or education may be considered as an equivalency on a one for one basis

Knowledge of Alberta, North American and global energy landscape.
Experience with investment attraction, market development, or resource competitiveness.
Experience working with industry, Indigenous organizations, governments, regulators, international investors or other strategic partners.
Experience managing human and financial resources and leading organisational change.
Advanced writing, briefing, engagement and presentation skills.
Ability to brief and present to senior leaders and Ministers.
Demonstrated ability to develop strategies, legislation, regulations and government decision documents such as cabinet reports.
Strong policial and financial acumen.

Minimum recruitment standards outline the minimum education and experience required for appointment to a job classification.

This is one full-time permanent position.

Petroleum Plaza Building, North Tower, Edmonton

or

Maintains awareness of relevant regulatory guidelines, including OSFI and CDIC requirements affecting Oracle platforms and related business functions.

Docker is the platform at the center of how intelligent software gets built. For more than a decade, Docker has helped millions of developers and thousands of organizations build, ship, and run software consistently across any environment. _______________________________________________________________________

The Role

The Director, Developer Success Engineering leads the technical half of Docker's Developer Success team: the senior engineers who build the demos, Labspaces, workshops, tech talks and technical content that show developers what Docker can do. This role gives that team a leader who can go deep on the technology, raise the bar on technical quality, and grow senior engineers in their careers. It owns three outcomes:

Own Docker's technical story for developers. Demos, Labspaces, reference applications and content that make AI Governance, Sandboxes, Docker Hardened Images and the core Docker experience easy to understand and adopt.
Turn technical content into adoption and revenue. Equip customer-facing teams, Captains and partners with enablement that lands and expands accounts, and measure its impact.
Be the developer's voice inside Docker. Bring hands-on feedback from developers, Captains and customers back to Product and Engineering so it shapes what Docker builds.

You report to the VP of Developer Success (DevRel & Docs) and lead a team of four staff and principal engineers. You work side by side with the Director, Developer Success Programmes, whose team runs the community, Captain, influencer and partner programmes your team's technical work powers.

You'll be successful if you are an engineer at heart who loves building and explaining technology, and who wants to multiply that impact through a team. The FY27 centre of gravity is product adoption and revenue enablement, not awareness metrics alone.

_______________________________________________________________________

Responsibilities

Own Docker's technical story for developers

Set the technical content strategy for Developer Success, aligned with Docker's product priorities: agentic development with Sandboxes, AI Governance, Docker Hardened Images and the core Docker experience.
Own the developer-facing product narrative for Captain briefings and launches, so the team delivers most briefings and demos itself rather than relying on ad hoc presenters.
Lead the Labspaces catalogue as Docker's reusable demo and learning format: every strategic demo, briefing, talk and workshop is packaged once and reused across Captains, revenue, partners, events and Docs.

Partner with Docs on hands-on learning content on docs.docker.com, including the Learn experience.

Turn technical content into adoption and revenue

Equip Solutions Engineers, Professional Services, Captains and partners to deliver Docker's story themselves, with kits that cut their demo preparation time.
Track the impact of technical enablement on product adoption, pipeline and expansion ARR, and report it alongside the programmes team.
Bring the team's technical depth to tier-1 events, partner work and the community programmes run by the Developer Success Programmes team.

Be the developer's voice inside Docker

Build structured feedback loops from developers, Captains and customers into Product and Engineering, including pre-launch reviews of new features.
Test new products early, report friction in the developer experience, and follow it through to fixes.
Represent Docker credibly in technical forums: conference talks, open source communities, technical blogs and developer communities.

Lead the team

Lead and grow a team of senior developer advocates and engineers: set clear goals, give technical and career coaching, and build growth paths for senior individual contributors.
Balance the team's capacity between strategic content, revenue enablement and inbound requests through a clear intake and prioritisation process.
Hire to fill capability gaps as Docker's product portfolio grows.

_______________________________________________________________________

Qualifications

A software engineering background, with deep hands-on knowledge of containers, Docker and modern developer workflows. You can build and debug a demo yourself.
Working knowledge of AI and agentic development (LLMs, agents, MCP) and of software supply chain security. Experience in either is a strong plus.
Experience leading a team of senior engineers, developer advocates or solutions engineers, and a track record of growing senior individual contributors.
A strong technical public presence: conference talks, workshops, technical writing or open source contributions.
Experience building technical enablement for sales, solutions or customer success teams, and tying it to adoption or revenue outcomes.
Ability to build trusted relationships with Product and Engineering leaders, and to influence roadmaps with evidence from developers.
Analytical and data-driven in how you prioritise and measure technical content and programmes.
Able to coordinate across many teams and perform in a fast-moving environment; self-directed, self-driven and able to prioritise strongly.
Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

_______________________________________________________________________

Get to know each team member, their technical focus areas, current work and career goals.
Get hands-on with Docker's products, especially Sandboxes, AI Governance and Docker Hardened Images, and run the team's top Labspaces and demos yourself.

Put in place an intake and prioritisation process with Revenue and Product so the team's capacity goes to the highest-impact work.

Become a trusted technical partner to Product, Engineering and marketing leadership.

Show a measurable link from technical enablement to product adoption and expansion revenue.
Establish a regular feedback channel from developers and Captains that visibly influences Docker's product roadmap.
Grow a team of senior engineers and advocates with clear career paths, recognised internally and externally for technical excellence.
Help Docker succeed in its vision to increase the time developers spend on innovation and decrease the time they spend on everything else.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Supervising Portfolio Manager to build, design, hire for and launch a new Supervising Portfolio Management team. By way of background, at Edward Jones we have been rapidly evolving and growing our Managed Account offering, and we are now launching an advisor-managed discretionary offering that allows our financial advisors to be licensed as Portfolio Managers and manage client portfolios on a discretionary basis.

To make this possible, and meet more clients' needs at scale, we need to stand up a Canadian Supervising Portfolio Management team who will have full responsibility for the design, implementation and ongoing execution of the supervisory framework governing the program.

What You'll Do

As we're just getting started, you will be asked to design our supervisory policies and procedures, set the standard advisors must meet to be admitted to the program, and figure out how the Supervising Portfolio Management team needs to be structured for enduring success.

As the functional leader and a licensed Supervising Portfolio Manager, once the team is launched, you will lead the team with overall responsibility for supervising financial advisors licensed as Portfolio Managers (PM) and Associate Portfolio Managers (APM), ensuring investment decisions made on behalf of clients align to Edward Jones' investment philosophy and meet a fiduciary standard.

To deliver on this, you will build out a team of licensed Portfolio Managers who bring deep expertise in portfolio construction, suitability and risk management, and who demonstrate the judgment and conviction to act whenever an investment decision is not in the client's best interest. Your team's responsibilities will include pre-approving APM models and trades, conducting account-level oversight against each client's Investment Policy Statement, and determining when an advisor is ready to be released from heightened supervision.

Just as important, you and your team will be a trusted partner to our financial advisors and branch teams, coaching advisor PMs and APMs and providing the feedback and development that elevates the quality of advice across the program. You will partner with Compliance, Legal, Operations and Technology to build supervisory controls that are automated and scalable, so Edward Jones can grow advisor-led discretionary management with confidence that every client receives high-quality advice and investment decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and build the Supervising Portfolio Management team, including the design, implementation and ongoing governance of the supervisory framework, policies and procedures for the firm's advisor-managed discretionary offering.
Act as the designated supervisory principal for the program, with final authority to approve or decline advisor entry into the program, and to determine when a newly licensed advisor is released from heightened supervision. Set the standard advisors must meet to be admitted and coach applicants to reach it.
Overall responsibility for how the team conducts ongoing supervisory reviews of advisor Portfolio Manager (PM) and Associate Portfolio Manager (APM) activity within discretionary accounts, identifying and resolving exceptions in a timely manner. Note that portfolios are centrally traded and centrally rebalanced, so supervision focuses on program-level oversight rather than individual trade execution.
Monitor portfolio activity across advisor-managed discretionary accounts for suitability, concentration risk, and adherence to client Investment Policy Statements (IPS). As portfolios are centrally designed and rebalanced in a uniform manner, supervision emphasizes program-level consistency rather than individual portfolio rebalancing.
Review and approve new discretionary models and pre-approve APM models and trades, ensuring they adhere to the firm's investment guidelines, and the diversification, risk and expected return characteristics are appropriate for the selected risk profile.
Attract, develop and engage talent, cultivating an inclusive environment, and own the development and execution of the team business plan.
Serve as the primary investment resource to advisor PMs and APMs, providing constructive feedback on the model portfolios, investment proposals and rebalancing strategies they develop, and coaching newly licensed APMs until they are proficient as full Portfolio Managers.
Oversee the performance measurement process for central models, acting as a data steward to ensure accurate and reliable returns are reported and used in marketing and client-facing materials.
Meet CIRO obligations as a permanent standing member of the Managed Account Committee (MAC), maintain supervisory records, and serve as the point of contact for regulatory examinations, internal audits and Compliance inquiries.
Continuously improve supervisory procedures to scale with the growth of the offering, partnering with Compliance, Operations, Wealth Platforms and Technology to automate controls and oversight.
10+ years of experience in portfolio management, including supervision of discretionary or managed accounts
Currently licensed or immediately able to be licensed as a Portfolio Manager with CIRO, with supervisory responsibilities
Bachelor's Degree or higher-level education
CFA Charter holder
Expert knowledge of CIRO rules governing managed and discretionary accounts and the fiduciary standard of care owed to discretionary clients.
Deep expertise in designing supervisory frameworks, written supervisory procedures (WSPs) and controls that scale program-level oversight.
Extensive knowledge of asset allocation, portfolio construction, risk management and IPS review, with the depth to assess and coach advisor investment decisions.
Proven ability to build a new function where no precedent exists, including the operating model, standards and team.
Seasoned judgment to make final supervisory decisions on behalf of clients and hold the line on standards, including declining an advisor's entry into the program, while preserving the relationship.
Demonstrated ability to coach licensed professionals, providing direct, constructive feedback that builds competency and elevates the quality of advice.

Baragar is entering a new chapter, one that builds on decades of service excellence while developing stronger internal accountability for its technology and product direction. Ce poste de direction est axé sur la transformation stratégique au sein de la division NEMA International d’ABB et relève du vice-président exécutif, ventes internationales. Il joue un rôle essentiel dans la mise en place d’une plateforme d’affaires internationales évolutive en renforçant l’alignement entre les régions, les secteurs d’activité et les fonctions, en éliminant les obstacles structurels à la croissance et en pilotant la mise en œuvre de la feuille de route Stabiliser-Optimiser-Déployer à grande échelle. La personne retenue pilotera la transformation des activités dans les différentes régions tout en établissant des fondations opérationnelles évolutives, en mettant à profit son expertise en exécution de la stratégie, en refonte des modèles opérationnels, en gestion des processus d’affaires, en leadership du changement et en influence auprès de la haute direction dans une structure matricielle mondiale complexe.

Le mode de travail pour ce poste est : hybride;

Ce poste contribue aux activités de la division Moteurs NEMA du secteur Motion à l’échelle mondiale.

Ce poste exige des déplacements internationaux représentant environ 30 à 40 % du temps de travail.

Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

Prendre en charge et piloter la feuille de route de transformation de NEMA International, en cohérence avec le parcours Stabiliser-Optimiser-Déployer à grande échelle, en traduisant la stratégie en initiatives prioritaires assorties de résultats, de jalons et de critères de réussite clairs, tout en assurant à la direction une visibilité sur les progrès et les risques.
Agir comme principal point d’intégration entre NEMA International et les secteurs d’activité mondiaux, en établissant des mécanismes de gouvernance et des engagements interfonctionnels qui alignent les priorités en matière de produits, de portefeuille et d’investissements sur les exigences des marchés internationaux, tout en portant à l’attention de la direction les interdépendances critiques qui freinent la croissance.
Piloter la résolution des obstacles systémiques aux interfaces entre les ventes internationales, les opérations mondiales, les TI, les finances, les RH et les autres fonctions de soutien, en regroupant les problèmes isolés en initiatives prioritaires visant leurs causes fondamentales, assorties de responsabilités claires et de résultats mesurables.

Diriger un bureau de transformation internationale au niveau de la haute direction, responsable du portefeuille de transformation, du rythme de gouvernance, du suivi des interdépendances et du signalement des risques, en mobilisant les chantiers interfonctionnels et en intervenant pour résoudre les lacunes dans l’attribution des responsabilités, les contraintes de ressources ou les retards décisionnels.
Piloter l’adoption de la nouvelle organisation internationale et des nouvelles façons de travailler grâce au leadership du changement, à la mobilisation des parties prenantes et au développement des capacités, tout en établissant un cadre d’amélioration continue qui relie les problèmes de première ligne aux améliorations structurelles des activités et intègre l’amélioration continue aux responsabilités de la direction.

Qualifications Requises Pour Le Poste

Au moins 10 ans d’expérience avec des responsabilités croissantes en transformation des activités, en exécution de la stratégie, en conception de modèles opérationnels, en excellence commerciale, en direction de programmes d’entreprise ou en conseil en gestion.
Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en administration des affaires, en génie, en stratégie, en gestion des opérations, en systèmes d’information ou dans une discipline connexe.
Expérience dans un rôle interne en stratégie, en transformation, en excellence opérationnelle ou en consultation.
Expérience démontrée dans la direction de transformations complexes et interfonctionnelles touchant plusieurs régions géographiques ou unités d’affaires.
Capacité éprouvée à rallier les parties prenantes de la haute direction et les fonctions autour de priorités communes, sans s’appuyer sur une autorité hiérarchique directe.
Expérience dans la traduction de la stratégie en feuilles de route réalisables, en structures de gouvernance, en mécanismes opérationnels et en résultats mesurables.
Solide sens des affaires et capacité à relier la transformation à la valeur pour la clientèle, à la croissance, aux marges, aux flux de trésorerie, à la productivité et aux capacités organisationnelles.
Excellentes aptitudes en communication auprès de la haute direction, en animation et en synthèse.
Capacité à remettre en question les pratiques établies de façon constructive et à évoluer dans l’ambiguïté avec rapidité et discernement.
Connaissance des modèles commerciaux internationaux, des environnements de gestion de la relation client (CRM) et de planification des ressources de l’entreprise (ERP), ainsi que des processus clients de bout en bout.
Une expérience dans un environnement industriel, manufacturier, électromécanique ou de technologies interentreprises (B2B) constitue un atout. Une certification reconnue en transformation, en gestion du changement, en Lean, en Six Sigma ou en gestion de programmes constitue un atout.
Maîtrise de l’anglais.

Pour en savoir plus sur nous

La division Moteurs NEMA d’ABB commercialise, conçoit et fabrique des moteurs électriques industriels Baldor-Reliance®, principalement en Amérique du Nord. La division mise sur la qualité, la fiabilité et l’efficacité afin d’offrir une gamme complète de moteurs NEMA sur le marché, couvrant la plupart des segments et des applications industriels.

Represent Docker credibly in technical forums: conference talks, open source communities, technical blogs and developer communities.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Supervising Portfolio Manager to build, design, hire for and launch a new Supervising Portfolio Management team. Your team's responsibilities will include pre-approving APM models and trades, conducting account-level oversight against each client's Investment Policy Statement, and determining when an advisor is ready to be released from heightened supervision.

Just as important, you and your team will be a trusted partner to our financial advisors and branch teams, coaching advisor PMs and APMs and providing the feedback and development that elevates the quality of advice across the program. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible
